# Contact-bundle harmonic stiffness cycle

Working derivation for V7, extending ledger75. This is determinant-lemma algebra for a prescribed harmonic model, not a new free-energy formula, molecular binding NA, or a quantum result. The earlier thermodynamic log-determinant quartet has verified prior art in Hawkins and McLeish (2006), ledger42, [primary repository PDF](https://eprints.whiterose.ac.uk/1500/1/mcleishtbc2.pdf), Eq2.3.

On one common projected internal coordinate space let \(K\) be SPD, and let columns of \(U,V\) be Cartesian edge-length gradients, projected into this space. Prescribed positive spring additions give

\[
K_{00}=K,\quad K_{10}=K+bVV^T,\quad K_{01}=K+aUU^T,\quad K_{11}=K+aUU^T+bVV^T,\qquad a,b\ge0.
\]

Here \(U\) denotes the X bundle and \(V\) the R bundle, matching Ada's later convention. This is only a label convention; there is no fit to the chemical substitutions. Set

\[
P=U^TK^{-1}U,\quad Q=V^TK^{-1}V,\quad R=U^TK^{-1}V,\quad A=I+aP,\quad B=I+bQ.
\]

The determinant lemma writes the combined determinant relative to the base as the determinant of the block matrix with diagonal blocks \(A,B\) and off-diagonal blocks \(\sqrt{ab}R\) and its transpose. Its Schur complement therefore gives

\[
\frac{\det K_{11}\det K_{00}}{\det K_{10}\det K_{01}}=\det(I-T^TT),\qquad T=\sqrt{ab}A^{-1/2}RB^{-1/2}.
\]

Thus the stiffness cycle in thermal units is

\[
\frac{\Delta F_K}{k_BT}=\frac12\log\det(I-T^TT)=\frac12\sum_i\log(1-\sigma_i(T)^2)\le0.
\]

Zero singular values contribute zero. For numerical work the finite cycle should use the small symmetric matrix and stable logarithms; an independent projected full log-determinant quartet checks the construction.

On the supports of \(P,Q\), define the whitened overlap \(C=P^{+1/2}RQ^{+1/2}\), where the exponent means the positive square root of the Moore-Penrose inverse. Its singular values \(s_i\) lie in \([0,1]\), because it is the overlap of orthonormal bases for the two column spaces after whitening by \(K^{-1/2}\). Dependent gradient columns are permitted. If compressed by SVD, keep the nonzero singular values so that \(UU^T\) and \(VV^T\) are unchanged.

The factorisation

\[
T=\big[\sqrt a A^{-1/2}P^{1/2}\big]\,C\,\big[\sqrt b Q^{1/2}B^{-1/2}\big]
\]

has left and right factors whose operator norms are at most one. Consequently each ordered singular value of \(T\) is bounded by the corresponding \(s_i\). If all \(s_i<1\),

\[
0\ge\frac{\Delta F_K}{k_BT}\ge\frac12\sum_i\log(1-s_i^2).
\]

This bound is approached when both positive additions tend to infinity on the supported spaces. If a singular value equals one, the two whitened update spaces overlap, and no finite uniform bound over arbitrarily large positive spring additions follows. Finite additions still give SPD quartet members and a finite cycle. A numerical value very close to one needs an explicit precision qualification, not arbitrary clipping. Empty bundles give zero cycle.

The bound is confined to these bundles and this harmonic baseline. A different ligand representation, spring rule, softening, or coordinate space changes it. It does not include the bound minimum-energy cycle, kinetic terms, coordinate Jacobian terms, basin/population terms, or the aqueous quartet (ledger38). None of these terms is controlled by a contact-bundle stiffness result, so this alone gives no bound on binding NA. The retained 22U structure is not four atom-matched B/F/E chemical states; it tests sensitivity of a prescribed contact model only.

For a compliance implementation, use a solve for each independent column of each bundle, restoring physical units and keeping column weights. The previous two-solve rank-one comparator is insufficient for general bundles. Quantum inverse readout likewise needs multiple quadratic/cross observables or a specified trace estimator, with all preparation, conditioning and precision costs. This derivation supplies no improved quantum resource theorem.

fixed_space_quote:
Work on the same SPD internal coordinate space at every corner, with temperature \(\theta=k_BT\). All minima, offsets, configurational measures and kinetic terms are fixed. Partition retained coordinates \(x\) from omitted coordinates \(z\), and write

\[
K=\begin{pmatrix}A&B\\B^T&D\end{pmatrix},\qquad S=A-BD^{-1}B^T.
\]

The four Hessians are \(K_{ij}=K+iUU^T+jVV^T\). Spring coefficients are absorbed into the bundle columns. For a joint bundle \(W=[U,V]\), partition \(W=[W_x^T,W_z^T]^T\). The exact Schur update is

\[
S'=S+L(I+W_z^TD^{-1}W_z)^{-1}L^T,
\qquad L=W_x-BD^{-1}W_z.
\]

Completing the square in \(z\) gives this formula; it is also a block Woodbury identity. It generalises Ada's single-column formula at ada/information-marginalisation.md:47-52. Independent bundles are generally mixed by the small inverse, so additive full Hessian updates need not stay additive after marginalisation.

There is a weaker sufficient preservation condition than requiring both bundles to be wholly retained. If \(V_z=0\), then

\[
S_{10}=S+L_U(I+U_z^TD^{-1}U_z)^{-1}L_U^T,
\quad S_{01}=S+V_xV_x^T,
\quad S_{11}=S_{10}+V_xV_x^T.
\]

Thus one can use an effective positive X bundle \(\widetilde U=L_U(I+U_z^TD^{-1}U_z)^{-1/2}\) and the original retained R bundle. The omitted determinant cycle vanishes, and the full stiffness cycle equals the retained cycle. Merely omitting an extra X nitrogen is not sufficient to break the representation; both substitutions must be checked against the omitted-coordinate map. This is a sufficient condition, not a necessary one. No actual chemical map is supplied by this algebra.

After reading joint21/22/27, the general formula supplies a stronger preservation criterion. If \(U_z^TD^{-1}V_z=0\), the joint inverse in the Schur update is block diagonal, so the reduced quartet is exactly additive in the two effective bundles even when both touch omitted coordinates. The omitted cycle also vanishes. This strengthens the qualification at ada/conditional-information.md:65: under the stated fixed SPD additive model, exact zero conditional cross-compliance does establish retained additivity. A merely small conditional information does not establish an exact additive representation, and none of these conditions validates chemical replacements.
scope: Existing retained definitions only. External model-visible projection unchanged. No new estimator, calibration, threshold, molecular mapping, computation or evidence fetch.
